title: Ish suhbati (intervyu)
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha ish suhbati (intervyu) savollariga ishonch bilan javob bera olasiz: o‘zingiz haqingizda 60 soniyalik taqdimot, STAR metodi bilan xulq-atvor savollarga javob, kuchli va kuchsiz tomonlaringizni dalil bilan taqdim etish, maosh kutilmalarini muloyim muhokama qilish, employerga kuchli savollar berish va suhbatdan keyingi minnatdorchilik xatini yozish.

vocab.uz: ishdan ketish haqida oldindan ogohlantirish davri

scenes.title: Ish suhbatiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bugun professional hayotning eng muhim sinovlaridan biri — ish suhbati, ya’ni intervyu haqida gaplashamiz. Ko‘pchilik yaxshi mutaxassis bo‘lsa ham, suhbatda hayajonlanib, noaniq javob beradi. Shu dars oxirida siz eng ko‘p uchraydigan intervyu savollariga ishonchli, professional inglizchada javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Today we tackle the job interview — one of the most important tests in professional life. By the end of this lesson you will answer the most common interview questions in confident, professional English.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! Bugun professional hayotning eng muhim sinovlaridan biri — ish suhbati bilan shug‘ullanamiz. Dars oxiriga kelib siz eng ko‘p uchraydigan intervyu savollariga ishonchli, professional inglizchada javob berasiz.

scenes.title: Suhbatdan oldin: tadqiqot va tayyorgarlik
board: CV, daftar va ID olib boring

examples.t: Do your research before the interview.

scenes.say_native: Suhbatga tayyorgarlik natijaning yarmi. Avval kompaniya saytini, yangiliklarini va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarini o‘rganing: mahsulotlari, qadriyatlari, yaqindagi yutuqlari. Keyin beshta eng ko‘p beriladigan savolga javobingizni yozib mashq qiling va employerga uchta savol tayyorlang. Suhbat kuni CV, daftar va ID olib boring.
scenes.say: Preparation is half the result. Study the company: website, news, social media. Rehearse answers to the five most common questions and prepare three of your own. On the day bring your CV, a notebook and an ID.
scenes.say_uz: Tayyorgarlik natijaning yarmi. Kompaniya saytini, yangiliklarini va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarini o‘rganing. Beshta eng ko‘p beriladigan savolga javob yozib mashq qiling va employerga uchta savol tayyorlang. Suhbat kuni CV, daftar va ID olib boring.

scenes.title: Intervyu bosqichlari: skriningdan ofergacha

examples.t: The first round is a screening call with HR.
examples.uz: Birinchi bosqich — HR bilan skrining suhbati.

scenes.say_native: Odatda intervyu to‘rt bosqichdan iborat. Birinchisi skrining suhbati: o‘n besh daqiqalik telefon yoki video, HR asosiy narsalarni aniqlaydi. Ikkinchisi HR suhbati: motivatsiya va kompaniyaga moslik. Uchinchisi menejer yoki texnik suhbat: haqiqiy ko‘nikmalar. To‘rtinchisi yakuniy bosqich.
scenes.say: Most interviews have four stages. First, a fifteen-minute screening call where HR checks the basics. Second, an HR interview on motivation and fit. Third, a manager or technical interview testing real skills. Fourth, the final stage.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pchilik intervyular to‘rt bosqichdan iborat. Birinchisi skrining suhbati — o‘n besh daqiqa, HR asosiy narsalarni aniqlaydi. Ikkinchisi HR suhbati — motivatsiya va moslik. Uchinchisi menejer yoki texnik suhbat — haqiqiy ko‘nikmalar. To‘rtinchisi yakuniy bosqich.

scenes.title: 60-soniyalik o‘zingiz haqida gapiring (Present–Past–Future)
board: Present — kim siz, hozir nima qilyapsiz
Past — eng muhim tajriba va yutuq
Future — nega shu ish va shu kompaniya
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p beriladigan savol: “Tell me about yourself.” Javobni uch qismga bo‘ling. Present: hozirgi lavozimingiz va asosiy vazifangiz. Past: eng kuchli yutuqingiz, raqam bilan. Future: nega shu kompaniya. Javob oltmish soniyadan oshmasin, qisqa va aniq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: The most common question is Tell me about yourself. Split it in three. Present: your current role. Past: your strongest achievement, with a number. Future: why this company and this role. Keep it under sixty seconds, short and specific.
scenes.say_uz: Eng ko‘p beriladigan savol: Tell me about yourself. Javobni uch qismga bo‘ling. Present — hozirgi lavozimingiz. Past — eng kuchli yutuqingiz, raqam bilan. Future — nega shu kompaniya va shu lavozim. Oltmish soniyadan oshmasin, qisqa va aniq bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Namunaviy taqdimot: Jasurning javobi
scenes.say_native: Endi namunani tinglang. Jasur uch qismga amal qiladi: hozirgi ishi, o‘tgan yilgi yutuq va nega aynan shu kompaniya. E’tibor bering: u umumiy gaplar emas, aniq raqam aytadi — o‘ttiz foiz o‘sish. Oxirida o‘zini kompaniyaga bog‘laydi, bu eng yaxshi yakun.
scenes.say: I am a marketing executive with four years of experience. In my current role I manage social and email marketing, and last year I lifted online engagement by thirty percent. Before this I worked at a small agency and learned to deliver under tight deadlines. I now want a bigger challenge — your data-driven approach is exactly how I work.
scenes.say_uz: Men to‘rt yillik tajribaga ega marketing ijrochisiman. Hozirgi lavozimimda ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va email marketingni olib boraman, o‘tgan yili onlayn jalb qilishni o‘ttiz foizga oshirdim. Bundan oldin kichik agentlikda ishladim va qisqa muddatlarda ishlashni o‘rgandim. Endi kattaroq qiyinchilik qidiryapman — sizning ma’lumotlarga asoslangan yondashuvingiz aynan menga mos.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni 60 soniyada tanishtiring
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz mashq qiling. O‘tirib oling, telefoningizga yozib oling yoki shunchaki ovoz chiqarib ayting. Present, Past, Future tartibida. Har qismni yigirma soniyadan ortiq cho‘zmang. Aniq raqam qo‘shishni unutmang — bu sizni boshqa nomzodlardan ajratadi.
scenes.say: Now practise. Record yourself or speak aloud in order: Present, Past, Future. Do not spend more than twenty seconds on each part. Include one concrete number — it sets you apart.
scenes.say_uz: Endi mashq qiling. O‘zingizni yozib oling yoki ovoz chiqarib ayting. Tartib: Present, Past, Future. Har qismga yigirma soniyadan ortiq vaqt sarflamang. Aniq raqam qo‘shing — u sizni boshqa nomzodlardan ajratadi.

scenes.title: STAR metodi: vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, natija
board: T — Task: sizning vazifangiz nima edi
R — Result: natija, iloji bo‘lsa raqam bilan

examples.t: Tell me about a time you worked under pressure.
examples.uz: Bosim ostida ishlaganingiz haqida gapirib bering.

scenes.say_native: Xulq-atvor savollari — “Tell me about a time when...” — hamma suhbatda bor. Bunga STAR metodi bilan javob beriladi. S — Situation: vaziyat. T — Task: vazifangiz. A — Action: aniq harakatlaringiz. R — Result: natija, iloji bo‘lsa raqam bilan. To‘rt qism to‘liq bo‘lmasa, javob ta’sir qilmaydi.
scenes.say: Behavioural questions — Tell me about a time when... — appear in every interview. Use STAR. S: Situation, set the scene. T: Task, your role. A: Action, the concrete steps you took. R: Result, the outcome, with a number if possible.
scenes.say_uz: Xulq-atvor savollari — Tell me about a time when... — har intervyuda bor. STAR metodidan foydalaning. S: Situation — vaziyat. T: Task — vazifangiz. A: Action — aniq qadamlaringiz. R: Result — natija, iloji bo‘lsa raqam bilan.

scenes.title: STAR misoli: qiyin loyiha
board: S: key client threatened to leave
T: fix deliveries in one month
R: on-time in 3 weeks, contract renewed
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy STAR javobni eshiting. Jasur avval vaziyatni qo‘yadi, keyin vazifasini, so‘ng uchta aniq qadamini aytadi va natijani raqam bilan yakunlaydi. E’tibor bering: u “we” emas, ko‘proq “I” ishlatadi — baholovchi sizning hissangizni eshitmoqchi.
scenes.say: Sure. A key client threatened to leave over late deliveries — the situation. My task: fix the process within a month. I mapped the bottleneck, introduced a weekly checklist, and reassigned two colleagues. Within three weeks deliveries were on time, and the client renewed the contract.
scenes.say_uz: Albatta. Asosiy mijozimiz yetkazib berish kechikkani uchun ketmoqchi edi — bu vaziyat edi. Mening vazifam jarayonni bir oy ichida tuzatish edi. Men tor joyni aniqladim, haftalik nazorat ro‘yxatini joriy qildim va ikki hamkasbning vazifasini qayta taqsimladim. Uch hafta ichida yetkazib berish o‘z vaqtida bo‘ldi va mijoz shartnomani yangiladi.

scenes.title: STAR bilan javob tuzing
board: Tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem.
scenes.say_native: Savol: “Tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem.” Haqiqiy ishdan bitta vaziyatni olib, to‘rt qismga bo‘lib ayting. Vaziyat bir jumlada, vazifangiz bir jumlada, harakatlaringiz ikki-uch jumlada, natija esa albatta raqam bilan.
scenes.say: Question: Tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem. Pick one real situation from your work: one sentence for the situation, one for your task, two or three for your actions, and a measurable result.
scenes.say_uz: Savol: Tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem. Ishingizdan bitta haqiqiy vaziyatni olib, javobni to‘rt qismga bo‘ling: vaziyatga bir jumla, vazifaga bir jumla, harakatlaringizga ikki-uch jumla, natijaga raqam.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kuchli STAR javob qanday tuziladi
board: A — “I did… I introduced… I reassigned…”
scenes.say_native: Keling, tahlil qilaylik. Vaziyat va vazifa bir-bir jumlada bo‘lishi shart — ba’zan nomzodlar shuni uch daqiqa cho‘zadi. Action qismida “I” bilan aniq fe’llar: mapped, introduced, reassigned. Natija o‘lchanadigan: uch hafta, shartnoma yangilandi. Shunday to‘liq javob ishonch beradi.
scenes.say: Analyse it. Situation and task fit one sentence each — candidates stretch them for minutes. In the action part use I with concrete verbs: mapped, introduced, reassigned. The result must be measurable: three weeks, contract renewed. A complete answer builds trust.
scenes.say_uz: Keling, tahlil qilaylik. Vaziyat va vazifa bir-bir jumladan oshmasin. Action qismida I bilan aniq fe’llar ishlating: mapped, introduced, reassigned. Natija o‘lchanadigan bo‘lsin: uch hafta, shartnoma yangilandi. Bunday to‘liq javob ishonch beradi.

scenes.title: Kuchli tomonlaringiz: dalil bilan ayting
board: Har biriga dalil: raqam yoki misol

examples.t: I'm organised — I plan my week every Sunday.
examples.uz: Men tartibli — har yakshanba haftamni rejalashtiraman.

scenes.say_native: “What are your strengths?” savoliga bitta umumiy so‘zning o‘zi yetmaydi. Bir-ikkita kuchli tomonni tanlang, har biriga dalil qo‘shing: raqam, natija yoki aniq odatingiz. Va buni lavozim talablariga bog‘lang — tashkilotchilik menejerlik ishiga, chidamlilik mijozlar bilan ishlashga mos keladi.
scenes.say: For What are your strengths?, one vague word is not enough. Pick one or two strengths and back each with evidence — a number, a result or a habit. Connect them to the role: organisation matters for management, resilience for client work.
scenes.say_uz: What are your strengths? savoliga bitta noaniq so‘z yetmaydi. Bir-ikkita kuchli tomonni tanlang va har biriga dalil qo‘shing: raqam, natija yoki odat. Lavozimga bog‘lang: tashkilotchilik menejment uchun, chidamlilik esa mijozlar bilan ishlash uchun kerak.

scenes.title: Kuchli tomon: ikkita namunaviy javob
scenes.say_native: Ikkita namunani eshiting. Birinchisida “organisation” so‘zi bor va dalili — ikki yil davomida hech qachon muddatni o‘tkazmagani. Ikkinchisida “teamwork” va dalil — uch chorak ketma-ket natijaga chiqqan jamoa. Har bir kuchli tomonning yonida “because” yoki raqam bor.
scenes.say: My main strength is organisation: I manage three projects at once and have never missed a deadline in two years — I plan every week on Sunday. A second is teamwork: our team hit its targets three quarters in a row because everyone knows their part.
scenes.say_uz: Mening asosiy kuchli tomonim — tashkilotchilik: bir vaqtda uchta loyihani boshqaraman va ikki yil ichida hech qachon muddatni o‘tkazmadim — har yakshanba haftamni rejalashtiraman. Ikkinchisi — jamoaviy ish: jamoamiz uch chorak ketma-ket maqsadga yetdi, chunki har kim o‘z vazifasini biladi.

scenes.title: Kuchli tomoningizni ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz ayting. Bitta kuchli tomoningizni tanlang, bir jumlada dalil keltiring va uni shu lavozimga bog‘lang. “I am good at... because...” strukturasida gapiring. O‘ttiz soniya yetadi, uzun javob kerak emas.
scenes.say: Your turn. One strength, one sentence of proof, linked to this role. Pattern: I am good at... because.... Thirty seconds is enough — a long answer is not needed.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz ayting. Bitta kuchli tomonni tanlang, bir jumlada dalil keltiring va shu lavozimga bog‘lang. Shunday gapiring: I am good at... because.... O‘ttiz soniya yetadi.

scenes.title: Kuchsiz tomon: zararsiz formulasi

examples.t: I'm working on my presentation skills.

scenes.say_native: “What are your weaknesses?” — tuzog‘i emas, balki tanqidiy fikrlash testi. Hech qachon “I have no weaknesses” demang, bu ishonchsiz eshitiladi. “I’m a perfectionist” kabi yaltiroq javoblar ham yaramaydi. Haqiqiy, lekin lavozim uchun halokatli bo‘lmagan kuchsiz tomonni tanlang va uni qanday yaxshilayotganingizni qo‘shing.
scenes.say: What are your weaknesses? tests self-awareness, not your confession. Never say I have no weaknesses, and avoid glossy answers like perfectionist. Choose a real but non-fatal weakness, and say what you are doing to improve it.
scenes.say_uz: What are your weaknesses? tuzog‘i emas — o‘zingizni qanchalik taniganingizni sinaydi. Hech qachon I have no weaknesses demang. I am a perfectionist kabi yaltiroq javoblardan ham qochamiz. Haqiqiy, lekin halokatli bo‘lmagan kuchsiz tomonni tanlang va uni qanday yaxshilayotganingizni ayting.

scenes.title: Kuchsiz tomon: namunaviy javob
scenes.say_native: Namuna javobni eshiting. Jasur haqiqiy kuchsiz tomonni aytadi — omma oldida gapirishdan qo‘rqish. Keyin aniq qadamini aytadi: ingliz tili klubi, har oy jamoa oldida prezentatsiya. Oxirida ochiq tan oladi: “hali sevimli vazifam emas”. Bu ishonchli javob.
scenes.say: Honestly, public speaking was my weakness — I used to freeze in meetings. I joined a small English club and now present to our team monthly. Not my favourite task yet, but I am noticeably better and more confident.
scenes.say_uz: Rostini aytganda, omma oldida gapirish mening kuchsiz tomonim edi — yig‘ilishlarda qotib qolardim. Men kichik ingliz tili klubiga qo‘shildim va endi har oy jamoam oldida prezentatsiya qilaman. Hali sevimli vazifam emas, lekin men sezilarli darajada yaxshilandim va ishonchliroq bo‘ldim.

scenes.title: Kuchsiz tomoningizni ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi siz ayting. O‘zingizdagi haqiqiy kuchsiz tomonni toping — masalan sekinlik, ishonchsizlik yoki jamoa bilan bo‘lishish. “I used to... but now I...” strukturasida gapiring va oxirida hozirgi holatingizni baholang. Yigirma-o‘ttiz soniya yetadi.
scenes.say: Now you. Find a real weakness — pace, confidence or sharing, not disguised perfectionism. Pattern: I used to... but now I.... Finish by assessing yourself today. Twenty to thirty seconds is enough.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz. Haqiqiy kuchsiz tomonni toping — temp, ishonch yoki jamoa bilan bo‘lishish, niqoblangan perfeksionizm emas. Shunday gapiring: I used to... but now I.... Oxirida bugungi holatingizni baholang. Yigirma-o‘ttiz soniya yetadi.

scenes.title: ‘Why this company?’ — qanday javob berish kerak

examples.t: Why do you want to work here?

scenes.say_native: Bu savol siz kompaniyani o‘rgangan-o‘rganmaganingizni sinaydi. “Yaxshi maosh” yoki “yaqin joyda” javobi sizni o‘chiradi. Buning o‘rniga bir-ikkita aniq fakt ayting: mahsuloti, madaniyati, yaqindagi yangiligi. Keyin uni o‘z qadriyatingiz bilan bog‘lang. Shu ikkalasi uchrashganda javob kuchli bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: This tests your research. Good salary or It is close to home would eliminate you. Instead, mention one or two concrete facts — a product, the culture, a recent launch — then link them to your values. Make the two meet.
scenes.say_uz: Bu savol siz kompaniyani o‘rgangan-o‘rganmaganingizni sinaydi. Good salary yoki It is close to home desak, safingizdan chiqarasiz. Buning o‘rniga bir-ikkita aniq fakt ayting — mahsulot, madaniyat, yaqindagi yangilik — keyin qadriyatlaringizga bog‘lang. Ikkalasini uchrashtiring.

scenes.title: Nega aynan shu kompaniya? Namunaviy javob
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javobni eshiting. Jasur ikkita aniq fakt aytadi: mentorlik dasturi va o‘quv byudjeti. Keyin o‘z tajribasini lavozim bilan bog‘laydi va “people are taken seriously” degan qadriyatini aytadi. Uch qatlam: fakt, moslik, qadriyat.
scenes.say: I admire how your company invests in employee growth — the mentorship programme and learning budget stood out. My experience in customer support matches the role, and I want to build my career where people are taken seriously, not just used.
scenes.say_uz: Sizning kompaniyangiz xodimlarning o‘sishiga qanday sarmoya kiritayotganiga qoyil qolaman — mentorlik dasturi va o‘quv byudjeti meni o‘ziga tortdi. Mijozlarga xizmat ko‘rsatishdagi tajribam lavozimga mos keladi va men odamlar hurmat qilinadigan va rivojlantiriladigan joyda karyeramni qurmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Kompaniya haqida javob tuzing
scenes.say_native: Endi siz. Tanlagan kompaniyangizdan bitta aniq faktni eslang, uni o‘z tajribangiz bilan bog‘lang va sababingizni qadriyat bilan yakunlang. Manba sifatida kompaniya sayti yoki yangiliklarini ishlating. O‘ttiz soniya gapiring.
scenes.say: Now you. One concrete fact about your chosen company, linked to your experience, closed with a value-driven reason. Speak for thirty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz. Tanlagan kompaniyangizdan bitta aniq faktni eslang, uni tajribangizga bog‘lang va qadriyatga asoslangan sabab bilan yakunlang. O‘ttiz soniya gapiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: nega aynan shu kompaniya — namunalar
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob uch qatlamdan iborat. Birinchi qatlam — fakt: kompaniya haqida aniq narsa. Ikkinchisi — moslik: tajribangiz lavozimga qanday to‘g‘ri kelishi. Uchinchisi — qadriyat: nega aynan shu yerda o‘smoqchisiz. Shu uch qatlamni zanjir qilib ayting, javobingiz ishonarli chiqadi.
scenes.say: Three layers. One, a fact: something specific about the company. Two, a match: how your experience fits the role. Three, a value: why you can grow here. Chain them together — the answer sounds credible.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli javob uch qatlamdan iborat. Birinchi qatlam — fakt: kompaniya haqida aniq narsa. Ikkinchi qatlam — moslik: tajribangiz lavozimga qanday to‘g‘ri kelishi. Uchinchi qatlam — qadriyat: nega aynan shu yerda o‘smoqchisiz. Uchchalasini zanjir qilib ayting, javob ishonarli chiqadi.

scenes.title: Kelajak rejasi haqidagi savolga javob
board: 'Where do you see yourself in five years?'

examples.t: In five years I see myself as a senior specialist.
examples.uz: Besh yildan keyin o‘zimni katta mutaxassis sifatida ko‘raman.

scenes.say_native: “Where do you see yourself in five years?” savoliga “CEO bo‘laman” javabi hazil bo‘lib qoladi. To‘g‘ri javob ambitsiya va realizm o‘rtasida: besh yildan keyin o‘zimni katta mutaxassis sifatida ko‘raman, ko‘proq mas’uliyat olaman va shu kompaniyada o‘smoqchiman. Yo‘nalishni ayting, lavozimni emas.
scenes.say: For Where do you see yourself in five years?, promising CEO sounds like a joke. Sit between ambition and realism: in five years I see myself as a senior specialist, taking more responsibility, growing inside this company. Name a direction, not a title.
scenes.say_uz: Where do you see yourself in five years? savoliga CEO bo‘laman javabi hazildek eshitiladi. To‘g‘ri javob ambitsiya va realizm o‘rtasida: Besh yildan keyin o‘zimni katta mutaxassis sifatida ko‘raman, ko‘proq mas’uliyat olaman va shu kompaniyada o‘smoqchiman. Lavozim emas, yo‘nalishni ayting.

scenes.title: Maosh kutilmalari: muloyim muloqot

examples.t: What salary range do you expect?

scenes.say_native: Maosh savoli eng nozik mavzu. Strategiya oddiy: raqamni birinchi siz aytmang. “I’m open to discussing the range” deng va “Could you share the budgeted band?” deb so‘rang — ular avval byudjetni aytadi. O‘sha payt bozor tadqiqotingizga tayanib, “That works for me” yoki “I was hoping for around X” deb javob bering.
scenes.say: Salary is the most delicate topic. Never name a number first. Say I'm open to discussing the range and ask Could you share the budgeted band? — let them speak first. With market research, answer That works for me or I was hoping for around X.
scenes.say_uz: Maosh eng nozik mavzu. Strategiya oddiy: raqamni birinchi aytmang. I'm open to discussing the range deng va Could you share the budgeted band? deb so‘rang — ular avval byudjetni aytadi. Javob bering: That works for me yoki I was hoping for around X.

scenes.title: Rasmiy registr va muloyim iboralar
board: Could you please… / I would appreciate…

examples.t: Thank you for the opportunity to interview.

scenes.say_native: Registr — ohang va rasmiylik darajasi. Intervyuda neytral-rasmiy ohang kerak: “Could you please...”, “I would appreciate...”, “I’d like to clarify...”. Do‘stona bo‘ling, lekin slangdan qoching. Yopilish iboralarini yodlang: “Thank you for the opportunity”, “I appreciate your time”.
scenes.say: Register means tone and formality level. Interviews need a neutral-formal tone: Could you please..., I would appreciate..., I'd like to clarify.... Be friendly, avoid slang. Memorise closing phrases: Thank you for the opportunity, I appreciate your time.
scenes.say_uz: Registr — ohang va rasmiylik darajasi. Intervyuda neytral-rasmiy ohang kerak: Could you please..., I would appreciate..., I'd like to clarify.... Do‘stona bo‘ling, lekin slangdan qoching. Yopilish iboralarini yodlang: Thank you for the opportunity, I appreciate your time.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tilidan o‘tadigan 6 xato
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilidan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri tarjima oltita xatoga olib keladi. “My English is good” o‘rniga darajangizni va uch yillik amaliyotingizni ayting. Maoshni birinchi nomlamang. Faqat yopiq savollar bermang. “I don’t know” o‘rniga “Let me think about that” deying. “Good” ga suyanmang. Tayyorgarliksiz kelmang.
scenes.say: Direct translation from Uzbek causes six mistakes. One: My English is good — state your level instead. Two: naming salary first. Three: closed questions only. Four: instead of I don't know, say Let me think about that. Five: leaning on good. Six: arriving with no research.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbekchadan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri tarjima oltita xatoga olib keladi. Bir: My English is good — o‘rniga darajangiz va yillar sonini ayting. Ikki: maoshni birinchi nomlash. Uch: faqat yopiq savollar. To‘rt: I don't know o‘rniga Let me think about that deying. Besh: good so‘ziga tayanish. Olti: tayyorgarliksiz kelish.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: HR bilan skrining intervyu
scenes.say_native: Tinglash matni birinchi bosqich skrining suhbati. HR asosiy savollarni beradi: tanishtiruv, nega kompaniya, maosh va boshlash vaqti. Jasur qisqa javob beradi va raqam aytadi. Bu suhbat odatda o‘n besh daqiqa bo‘ladi. Diqqat bilan tinglang, savollar keyin beriladi.
scenes.say: HR: Thanks for applying. Quick intro? Jasur: Sure — four years in digital marketing: social media, email campaigns; I lifted online engagement thirty percent last year. HR: Why us? Jasur: Your data-driven approach matches how I work. HR: Salary expectations? Jasur: I'm open to discussing the range. What is the budgeted band? HR: Around one to twelve hundred dollars. Jasur: That works — I can start in two weeks. HR: Great — we'll invite you to the next round.
scenes.say_uz: HR: Arizangiz uchun rahmat. Tez tanishtirib o‘ting. Jasur: Albatta — digital marketingda to‘rt yil: ijtimoiy tarmoqlar, email kampaniyalar; o‘tgan yili onlayn jalb qilishni o‘ttiz foizga oshirdim. HR: Nega biz? Jasur: Sizning ma’lumotlarga asoslangan yondashuvingiz men ishlaydigan uslubga mos. HR: Maosh bo‘yicha kutilmalar? Jasur: I'm open to discussing the range. Byudjet qancha? HR: Taxminan bir mingdan bir ikki yuz dollargacha. Jasur: Bu menga to‘g‘ri keladi — ikki haftadan keyin boshlay olaman. HR: Ajoyib — sizni keyingi bosqichga taklif qilamiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: Eshitganingizni eslang va to‘rt savolga javob bering: lavozim nomi, jalb qilish o‘sish foizi, HR aytgan byudjet va Jasur qachon boshlay olishi. Javoblarni ichingizda ayting, keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Recall the call and answer four questions: the role, the engagement growth, the budgeted band, and when Jasur can start. Say your answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘ng‘iroqni eslang va to‘rt savolga javob bering: lavozim, jalb qilish o‘sishi, HR aytgan byudjet va Jasur qachon boshlay olishi. Javoblarni ichingizda ayting — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: Marketing Executive lavozimi. Ikkinchisi: o‘ttiz foiz — Jasur aniq raqam aytdi. Uchinchisi: bir mingdan bir ikki yuz dollargacha byudjet. To‘rtinchisi: ikki haftadan keyin. Jasur maoshni birinchi aytmadi — “I’m open to discussing the range” dedi, bu muloyim strategiya.
scenes.say: Answers. One: Marketing Executive. Two: thirty percent. Three: one to twelve hundred dollars. Four: in two weeks. Jasur did not name the salary first — I'm open to discussing the range — the polite strategy.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: Marketing Executive. Ikki: o‘ttiz foiz — Jasur aniq raqam aytdi. Uch: bir mingdan bir ikki yuz dollargacha. To‘rt: ikki haftadan keyin. Jasur maoshni birinchi aytmadi — I'm open to discussing the range dedi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: menejer bilan final suhbati
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — menejer bilan final bosqichi. U xulq-atvor savoli beradi: qiyin shaxs bilan qanday ishlagansiz. Jasur STAR tuzilmasida javob beradi: vaziyat, harakat, natija. Keyin kuchsiz tomonini aytadi va oxirida employerga savol beradi.
scenes.say: Manager: Tell me about a time you handled a difficult stakeholder. Jasur: A sales director kept rejecting our campaign drafts. I met him weekly, asked which metrics mattered, and rebuilt the proposal around them. Within a month he approved — it became our top performer. Manager: Your main weakness? Jasur: Public speaking — I used to freeze, but I now present monthly. Manager: Any questions for me? Jasur: What does success look like in the first three months? Manager: Clean onboarding and one launched campaign.
scenes.say_uz: Manager: Qiyin shaxs bilan qanday ishlaganingiz haqida gapirib bering. Jasur: Savdo direktori kampaniya eskizlarimizni doim rad etardi. Men u bilan har hafta uchrashdim, muhim ko‘rsatkichlarni so‘radim va taklifni ular atrofida qayta qurdim. Bir oy ichida u tasdiqladi — bu eng yaxshi natijali kampaniyamizga aylandi. Manager: Asosiy kuchsiz tomoningiz? Jasur: Omma oldida gapirish — oldin qotib qolardim, endi har oy prezentatsiya qilaman. Manager: Sizda savol bormi? Jasur: Dastlabki uch oyda muvaffaqiyat nimadan iborat? Manager: Ravon sinov davri va bitta ishga tushgan kampaniya.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
board: 1 How did Jasur handle the sales director?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savolga javob bering. Birinchisi: Jasur savdo direktori bilan qanday kelishdi? Ikkinchisi: uning kuchsiz tomoni nima edi va u nima qildi? Uchinchisi: menejerga qanday savol berdi? To‘rtinchisi: menejer muvaffaqiyatni qanday ta’rifladi? Keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: how did Jasur handle the sales director? Two: his weakness and what he did. Three: his question to the manager. Four: how did the manager define success? We check next.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: Jasur savdo direktori bilan qanday kelishdi? Ikki: kuchsiz tomoni nima edi va u nima qildi? Uch: menejerga qanday savol berdi? To‘rt: menejer muvaffaqiyatni qanday ta’rifladi? Keyin tekshiramiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: Jasur har hafta u bilan uchrashdi, muhim ko‘rsatkichlarni so‘radi va taklifni ularga qarab qayta qurdi. Ikkinchisi: omma oldida gapirish; endi har oy jamoa oldida prezentatsiya qiladi. Uchinchisi: dastlabki uch oyda muvaffaqiyat nimadan iboratligini so‘radi. To‘rtinchisi: ravon sinov davri va bitta ishga tushgan kampaniya.
scenes.say: Answers. One: he met the director weekly, asked which metrics mattered, and rebuilt the proposal around them. Two: public speaking — he now presents monthly. Three: he asked what success looks like in the first three months. Four: clean onboarding and one launched campaign.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: u direktor bilan har hafta uchrashdi, muhim ko‘rsatkichlarni so‘radi va taklifni ularga qarab qayta qurdi. Ikki: omma oldida gapirish; endi har oy jamoa oldida prezentatsiya qiladi. Uch: dastlabki uch oyda muvaffaqiyat nimadan iboratligini so‘radi. To‘rt: ravon sinov davri va bitta ishga tushgan kampaniya.

scenes.title: Employerga so‘raladigan kuchli savollar
board: 1 'What does success look like in this role?'
3 'What are the biggest challenges right now?'
4 'How do you support growth and learning?'
5 'What are the next steps in the process?'
scenes.say_native: “Do you have any questions?” — bu savol emas, imkoniyat. “What does success look like in this role?” natijaga yo‘nalganligingizni ko‘rsatadi. “How is the team structured?” — jamoa haqida. “What are the biggest challenges right now?” — muammoni ko‘ra olishingizni. “How do you support growth and learning?” rivojlanishga intilishingizni. Va beshinchisi — keyingi qadamlarni so‘rash.
scenes.say: Do you have any questions? is an opportunity, not a question. Success-look-like shows outcome focus; team structure shows awareness; biggest challenges shows problem-spotting; growth support shows ambition. And always ask about the next steps.
scenes.say_uz: Do you have any questions? savol emas — imkoniyat. What does success look like in this role? natijaga yo‘nalganligingizni ko‘rsatadi. How is the team structured? — jamoa haqida. What are the biggest challenges right now? — muammoni ko‘ra olishingizni. How do you support growth? — rivojlanishga intilishingizni. Va nihoyat, keyingi qadamlar haqida so‘rang.

scenes.title: Employerga ikkita savol tuzing
scenes.say_native: Endi siz. Yuqoridagi beshta savoldan ikkitasini tanlang yoki o‘zingizning ikkita savolingizni tuzing. Ularni ovoz chiqarib, inglizcha aytib ko‘ring. Savollaringiz aniq va qisqa bo‘lsin, javobi “ha” yoki “yo‘q” bo‘lmagan savollar eng kuchli hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: Your turn. Pick two of the five questions, or write your own. Say them aloud in English. Keep them short — the strongest questions are not yes-or-no.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz. Yuqoridagi beshta savoldan ikkitasini tanlang yoki ikkita o‘z savolingizni tuzing. Ularni inglizcha ovoz chiqarib ayting. Qisqa va aniq bo‘lsin — eng kuchli savollar ha/yo‘q savollari emas.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kuchli savollar namunasi
board: 'What does success look like here in 90 days?'
'Who will I work with most closely?'
'What would you want me to deliver in the first month?'
scenes.say_native: Namuna savollarga qarang. “What does success look like here in the first ninety days?” — uzoq emas, yaqin natijaga e’tibor. “Who will I work most closely with?” — jamoa va munosabatlar haqida. “What would you want me to deliver in the first month?” — konkret natija. Bular ishga kirishishga tayyorligingizni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Models: What does success look like in the first ninety days? — near-term outcomes. Who will I work most closely with? — team and relationships. What would you want me to deliver in the first month? — a concrete result. Ready to contribute, not just to be hired.
scenes.say_uz: Namunalarga qarang. What does success look like in the first ninety days? — yaqin natijaga e’tibor. Who will I work most closely with? — jamoa va munosabatlar haqida. What would you want me to deliver in the first month? — konkret natija. Bular shunchaki ishga kirishga emas, hissa qo‘shishga tayyor ekaningizni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Tana tili va video intervyu
board: Video: kamera ko‘z darajasida, yorug‘ xona
scenes.say_native: Birinchi taassurotni tana tili beradi. Ko‘z muloqoti, tabassum, tik o‘tirish — uch ishonch belgisi. Video intervyuda kamerani ko‘z darajasiga qo‘ying, ortingizni sokin va yorug‘ tanlang, shovqin yo‘q bo‘lsin. Kiyimni suhbat turiga qarab tanlang. Javobdan oldin ikki-uch soniya o‘ylashdan qo‘rqmang — bu jiddiylik belgisi.
scenes.say: Body language creates the first impression: eye contact, a smile, upright posture. In video interviews place the camera at eye level, choose a quiet, well-lit room. Do not fear a two-to-three-second pause — it shows seriousness, not weakness.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi taassurotni tana tili yaratadi: ko‘z muloqoti, tabassum, tik o‘tirish. Video intervyuda kamerani ko‘z darajasiga qo‘ying, sokin va yorug‘ xonani tanlang. Javobdan oldin ikki-uch soniyalik pauzadan qo‘rqmang — bu jiddiylik belgisi.

scenes.title: Rol o‘yini: mock intervyu
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq mock intervyu. Do‘stingiz yoki yozib olish moslamangizni ishga soling va to‘rt savolga ketma-ket javob bering: tanishtiruv, kuchli tomon, STAR savol va maosh. Har javobni oltmish soniyadan oshirmang. Keyin yozib olganingizni tinglab, xatolaringizni belgilang va qayta yozing.
scenes.say: Now a full mock interview. With a friend or a recorder, answer four questions in a row: intro, strengths, a STAR question, salary. Under sixty seconds each. Listen back, note mistakes, record again.
scenes.say_uz: Endi to‘liq mock intervyu. Do‘stingiz yoki yozib olish qurilmangizni ishga soling va to‘rt savolga ketma-ket javob bering: tanishtiruv, kuchli tomon, STAR savol, maosh. Har javobni oltmish soniyadan oshirmang. Tinglang, xatolaringizni belgilang va qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Suhbatdan keyin: minnatdorchilik xati

examples.t: Thank you for your time today.

scenes.say_native: Suhbat tugaganidan keyin yigirma to‘rt soat ichida qisqa minnatdorchilik xati yuboring. Uch qator yetadi: “Thank you for your time today. I am even more excited about the role. I look forward to the next steps.” Bu sizni jiddiy va hurmatli nomzod sifatida eslatadi.
scenes.say: Within twenty-four hours, send a short thank-you email. Three lines: Thank you for your time today. I am even more excited about the role. I look forward to the next steps. It reminds them of a serious, respectful candidate.
scenes.say_uz: Suhbatdan keyin yigirma to‘rt soat ichida qisqa minnatdorchilik xati yuboring. Uch qator yetadi: Thank you for your time today. I am even more excited about the role. I look forward to the next steps. Bunday xat sizni jiddiy va hurmatli nomzod sifatida eslatadi.

scenes.title: Ofer, rad etish va keyingi qadamlar
scenes.say_native: Ofer kelganda darrov “ha” demang — shartnomani o‘qing: maosh, soliq, ish vaqti, ta’tilni tekshiring va qirq sakkiz soat o‘ylash uchun so‘rang. Lavozim to‘g‘ri kelmasa, muloyim rad eting: “Thank you for the offer. Unfortunately I will have to decline.” Va suhbat oxirida doim “What are the next steps?” deb so‘rang.
scenes.say: When an offer arrives, don't say yes at once. Read the contract — salary, tax, hours, holidays — and ask for forty-eight hours. If the role is not right, decline politely: Thank you for the offer. Unfortunately I will have to decline. And always ask: What are the next steps?
scenes.say_uz: Ofer kelganda darhol ha demang. Shartnomani o‘qing — maosh, soliq, ish vaqti, ta’til — va qirq sakkiz soat o‘ylash uchun ruxsat so‘rang. Lavozim mos kelmasa, muloyim bosh torting: Thank you for the offer. Unfortunately I will have to decline. Va har intervyuda so‘rang: What are the next steps?

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Keling, xulosa qilamiz. “Tell me about yourself” — Present, Past, Future tartibida oltmish soniya. Xulq-atvor savollarga STAR bilan javob bering: vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, raqamli natija. Kuchli tomon — dalil bilan; kuchsiz tomon — “I used to... but now...”. Maoshni birinchi aytmang. Employerga ham o‘zingiz savol bering.
scenes.say: Sum up. Tell me about yourself in sixty seconds — Present, Past, Future. Behavioural questions get STAR. Strengths need evidence; weaknesses use I used to... but now.... Never name salary first; keep a formal register. Ask the employer questions too.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Tell me about yourself oltmish soniyada — Present, Past, Future. Xulq-atvor savollariga STAR bilan javob bering: vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, raqamli natija. Kuchli tomon dalil bilan; kuchsiz tomon I used to... but now... shaklida. Maoshni birinchi aytmang; rasmiy registr saqlang. Employerga ham savol bering.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: besh intervyu savoliga javobingizni yozib oling — tanishtiruv, kuchli tomon, kuchsiz tomon, STAR savol va maosh. Har javob oltmish soniyadan oshmasin, STAR to‘liq bo‘lsin va maosh javobida “I’m open to discussing the range” iborasidan foydalaning. Keyingi darsda rezyume va o‘zingizni taqdim etishni o‘rganamiz. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: record answers to five interview questions — intro, strength, weakness, a STAR question, salary. Under sixty seconds each, with a complete STAR. Next lesson: your resume and self-presentation. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: besh intervyu savoliga javobingizni yozib oling — tanishtiruv, kuchli tomon, kuchsiz tomon, STAR savol, maosh. Har javob oltmish soniyadan oshmasin, STAR to‘liq bo‘lsin, maosh javobida I'm open to discussing the range dan foydalaning. Keyingi dars: rezyume va o‘zingizni taqdim etish. Omad tilayman!

homework_uz: Besh intervyu savoliga javobingizni 60 soniyadan yozib oling: (1) Tell me about yourself, (2) kuchli tomoningiz, (3) kuchsiz tomoningiz, (4) STAR savol — qiyin vaziyatni qanday hal qilganingiz, (5) maosh kutilmalari. Har javobda bir aniq raqam yoki misol keltiring; yozib olingizni tinglab, xatolaringizni daftarga yozing va beshala javobni qayta mashq qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: beshala javob 60 soniyadan oshmasin, STAR to‘liq bo‘lsin va maosh savoliga muloyim javob berilgan bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: P1-02 Rezyume va o‘zini taqdim etish.

quiz.q: What does the 'R' in STAR stand for?
quiz.why_uz: STAR — Situation, Task, Action, Result; natija o‘lchanadigan bo‘lishi kerak, iloji bo‘lsa raqam bilan.

quiz.q: How long should 'Tell me about yourself' be?
quiz.why_uz: Oltmish soniya yetarli: Present, Past, Future — har biri bir-bir jumlada aytiladi.

quiz.q: Which is the best way to answer 'What are your weaknesses?'
options: A real weakness plus what you are doing to improve
The biggest weakness you can think of
quiz.why_uz: Haqiqiy, lekin halokatli bo‘lmagan kuchsiz tomon va aniq yaxshilanish rejasi eng ishonchli javob; “I have no weaknesses” xudbindek, “perfectionist” esa yaltiroq eshitiladi.

quiz.q: What is the politest way to handle a salary expectation question?
options: Name the highest number you can think of
'I'm open to discussing the range. What is the budgeted band?'
quiz.why_uz: Raqamni birinchi aytmaslik va byudjetni so‘rash — eng muloyim va strategik yondashuv; bozor tadqiqotiga tayanib keyin javob beriladi.

quiz.q: Which question should you ask the employer?
options: 'What does success look like in this role?'
quiz.why_uz: Natijaga yo‘naltirilgan savollar qiziqishingizni va fikrlashingizni ko‘rsatadi; faqat imtiyoz haqida so‘rash sizni o‘chiradi.

quiz.q: What should you do within 24 hours after an interview?
options: Post about it on social media
quiz.why_uz: Qisqa minnatdorchilik xati sizni jiddiy va hurmatli nomzod sifatida eslatadi; kundalik qo‘ng‘iroq esa bezovta qiladi.

options: 'I am organised — I plan every Sunday and never missed a deadline in two years.'
quiz.why_uz: Kuchli tomon dalil yoki raqam bilan aytilganda ishonchli bo‘ladi; umumiy sifatlarning o‘zi yetmaydi.

quiz.q: How should you answer 'Tell me about a time you failed'?
options: Describe a real failure, what you learned and how you improved
quiz.why_uz: Baholovchi tanqidiy fikrlash va o‘rganish qobiliyatingizni qidiradi; haqiqiy xato + saboq + yaxshilanish eng kuchli javob.

quiz.q: The STAR method helps you structure…
quiz.why_uz: “Tell me about a time when…” tipidagi xulq-atvor savollari STAR — vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, natija — bilan to‘liq javolanadi.

quiz.q: What is the first step in preparing for an interview?
options: Ask a friend to call you
quiz.why_uz: Kompaniyani o‘rganish — mahsulotlari, yangiliklari, qadriyatlari — savollarga aniq va shaxsiy javob berishga yordam beradi.
